subject: Intro: Redwood demo for Archimedes Health — intake questions & availability
messages:
From: Sofia Gomez <sofia.gomez@archimedeshealth.com>
To: ava.chen@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo request from signup form — Archimedes Health

Hi Ava,

I signed up through the Redwood site and asked for a demo — thanks for the quick follow-up. A little context on our side: we run inference for clinical document summarization and triage across multiple hospitals. Current monthly token volume is around ~45M tokens, and we expect that to double in the next 6 months. Key constraints: low latency for triage (p95 under 300ms), strict PHI handling, and SOC2-compliant audit trails.

Would love a 30–40 minute walkthrough focused on throughput and security controls. Our timeline for a POC is Q4 (Oct/Nov) and we have a procurement window in early Q1.

Available times for a demo: Tue 9/29 between 10–12 PT or Wed 9/30 after 1pm PT.

I attached a short deck with our current infra notes (archimedes_prod_requirements.xlsx).

Thanks,
Sofia Gomez
Head of Platform Integrations
Archimedes Health
[Attachment: archimedes_prod_requirements.xlsx]

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Gomez <sofia.gomez@archimedeshealth.com>, alex.martinez@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request from signup form — Archimedes Health

Hi Sofia — thanks for the context and the attachment, really helpful. I’m Ava (SDR) on the team; looping in Alex Martinez (solutions lead) so we can tailor the demo. A few quick clarifying Qs before we lock a slot so Alex can prep the right load/perf numbers: 

• Can you confirm whether the 45M tokens/month is mostly short clinical notes (~200–300 tokens each) or longer discharge summaries (~1k+ tokens)?
• Do you plan to host PHI on your VPC/on-prem, or would you prefer Redwood Private with customer-managed keys?
• Are you expecting many concurrent streams (real-time triage) versus batch inference for nightly processing?

For availability I can offer:
• Tue 9/29 10:30–11:00 PT (30m) — quick throughput/ops-focused demo
• Wed 9/30 1:30–2:10 PT (40m) — includes short arc on Private deployment and security

If neither works, tell us a couple of slots and we’ll do our best to accommodate. Also I uploaded the deck to our shared demo folder: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/archimedes-demo-2026 (Alex will add a short runbook).

Best,
Ava Chen
Enterprise SDR, Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0123
[Redwood Inference]

From: Sofia Gomez <sofia.gomez@archimedeshealth.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, alex.martinez@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 08:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request from signup form — Archimedes Health

Thanks Ava — quick answers below.

• Token profile: about 70% short notes (200–350 tokens), 30% longer summaries (avg ~900 tokens).
• PHI handling: must remain on our side; preference is Redwood Private (VPC) or your on-prem offering.
• Concurrency: peak concurrent streams are relatively low (~25–40 parallel requests), but we need consistent p95 latency under load. Nightly batch jobs also exist for backfill.

Wed 9/30 1:30–2:10 PT works well for us. Please send a calendar invite.

Also, can you share a short checklist of the security artifacts you expect (SOC2, encryption-in-transit, KMS, log retention settings)? I’ll pass that to procurement ahead of the POC.

Best,
Sofia
[Attachment: archimedes_prod_requirements.xlsx]

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Gomez <sofia.gomez@archimedeshealth.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request from signup form — Archimedes Health

Hi Sofia — great, thanks for the details and for locking Wed 1:30 PT. I’ve sent a calendar invite for Wed 2026-09-30 13:30–14:10 PT (Google Meet link included).

Prep notes for the demo (what we’ll cover):
1) Quick platform overview (5m): hosting modes — Hosted API, Dedicated, Private (VPC/on-prem)
2) Performance & cost profile (10m): expected throughput for your token mix, example autoscaling and batching settings to hit p95 targets
3) Security & compliance checklist (10m): SOC2, TLS, KMS integrations, audit log retention — I’ll attach our standard security checklist after the call
4) Next steps (5m): POC options, procurement timeline, and an example mutual action plan

Attachments I’ll send post-demo: redwood-security-checklist.pdf, demo-runbook.pdf.

If there’s anything specific you want us to demo (e.g., KV cache behavior with long summaries, or routing fallbacks), reply to this thread and we’ll slot it in. Looking forward to meeting.

Cheers,
Alex Martinez
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
[Calendar invite: Redwood Demo — Archimedes Health — Wed Sep 30 13:30 PT]
